Almgren Wins NYC Marathon Debut, Chepkirui Takes Women's Race

Andreas Almgren won the New York City Marathon in his first attempt at the distance. In the women's race, Sheila Chepkirui emerged victorious in a contest featuring past champions. The coverage also noted details such as start times for the 2026 race and highlighted an 83-year-old participant preparing for his 51st marathon.
